clauses.mechanism: termination of the Great Lakes Basin Commission on 1981-09-30 under EO 12319 Sec. 1(b); the amended sections of EO 11345 concern only that Commission; alternative first end 1981-10-01 (revocation of EO 11345 as amended, Sec. 5(a))
clauses.reason: whole: EO 11646 (signed 1972-02-08, 37 FR 2925) amends two sections of EO 11345 (Great Lakes Basin Commission): Sec. 1 inserts the Department of State among the Commission's members in Sec. 3(2) and Sec. 2 restates Sec. 5 on international coordination between the Council and the Department of State; it has no own-terms end. First end: EO 12319 (signed 1981-09-09, 46 FR 45591), which states that, in accord with a decision of the Water Resources Council, "the follow ing river b asin  com m issions sh all term inate on the date" indicated, and lists "(b) G reat Lakes B asin  Com m ission, term inated on Septem ber 30,1981." Both amended sections concern only the Commission's membership and coordination, so the clause ended when the Commission terminated, recorded as 1981-09-30. The same order then provides (Sec. 5(a)) "(a) E ffective O ctober 1, 1981, the follow ing Execu tive O rders are" revoked, listing "(2) Execu tive O rder No. 11345, as am ended, w hich establish ed  the G reat L akes" (Basin Commission): the revocation of the parent order as amended took effect on 1981-10-01, one day after the Commission's termination, and is recorded as a later event; if a reviewer reads the clause as lasting until the parent order was revoked, the first end is 1981-10-01 instead. EO 12319 does not name EO 11646 by number; the end rests on the Commission's termination and the revocation of EO 11345 'as amended'. The OFR catalog note on the target reads "Revoked by: EO 12319, September 9, 1981" (the signing date of the order whose Secs. 1 and 5 act on 1981-09-30 and 1981-10-01). Later events on the clause: EO 11882 (signed 1975-10-06) adds the Energy Research and Development Administration to Sec. 3(2) and EO 12038 (effective as of 1977-10-01 by its Sec. 6) substitutes the Department of Energy for it; both amend the same membership list, leave the Department of State insertion in place and are amendment events, not ends (owner ruling 2026-10-21 strike-and-insert).

EO 11646 (signed 1972-02-08, 37 FR 2925) read in full from the held official FR text, with EO 12319, EO 11882 and EO 12038 read in the relevant parts from held FR texts. Identity confirmed. The order is a two-section amendment of EO 11345 (membership; international coordination). First end: the Great Lakes Basin Commission's termination on 1981-09-30 under EO 12319 Sec. 1(b) (decision of the Water Resources Council recited in the order), with the revocation of EO 11345 'as amended' effective 1981-10-01 (Sec. 5(a)) recorded as a later event and as the alternative first end. EO 11646 is not named by number in EO 12319; this is stated in the clause reason. The dossier's ACT leads cite the APP mirror of EO 12319; I used the held FR text.
